should_trigger: Turn these notes into a project proposal for leadership.
Write a business case for funding this migration.
Create a project charter with scope, milestones, and risks.
Help me pitch this internal automation initiative.
Draft an approval proposal for replacing our support platform.
should_not_trigger: Break this approved project into tasks.
Write a decision memo comparing two vendors.
Create a technical runbook for the migration.
Write landing-page copy for our consulting service.

tasks.prompt: Draft a proposal to automate invoice reconciliation for a finance team processing 8,000 invoices monthly, with a three-month pilot.
criteria: Leads with a concrete decision request
Defines measurable outcomes, scope, milestones, and resources
Labels assumptions and avoids invented ROI

tasks.prompt: Create a one-page concept proposal for an idea with little evidence: an internal AI search tool for support agents.
criteria: Defines discovery or pilot exit criteria
Includes alternatives, risks, and next decision

tasks.prompt: Write a migration proposal for replacing a legacy CRM while maintaining sales operations.
criteria: Covers phased scope and operational continuity
